company.about: Avenyra Global provides integrated human resource outsourcing, recruitment and workforce management solutions.
company.mission: To provide human resource outsourcing, recruitment and workforce solutions that help organisations attract capable people and manage them well.

services.title: Staff augmentation
services.summary: Screened employees and contractors who join the client’s daily stand-up.
services.body: Use Northbridge when you need named people on your tools and calendar. We run recruiting, classification, onboarding, and replacement so your managers can direct the work.

services.title: Managed teams
services.summary: A Northbridge lead plus a pod measured on throughput, not headcount.
services.body: We staff a pod (operations, finance ops, CX, or engineering support), appoint a delivery lead, and report against an agreed operating cadence.

services.title: Process outsourcing
services.summary: Take a repeatable process—AP, KYC support, tier-1 CX—and run it end to end.
services.body: SOP, quality sampling, and workforce planning sit with us. You keep policy control and a named executive sponsor.

jobs.title: Customer operations lead
jobs.summary: Own a 12-person CX pod for a healthcare-admin client. Quality, scheduling, and escalation.
jobs.description: You will sit between the client operations director and Northbridge HR. Hire from our bench, run daily huddles, and keep QA above the contracted sample rate. Healthcare experience preferred; HIPAA training provided.

jobs.title: Accounts payable specialist
jobs.summary: Invoice capture, three-way match, vendor queries for a mid-market manufacturer.
jobs.description: NetSuite or similar ERP experience required. 6-month contract with conversion intent. Must complete Northbridge contractor checklist before badge pickup.

jobs.title: Talent partner (internal)
jobs.summary: Fill client reqs and keep the careers site honest.
jobs.description: Internal recruiting role. You will live in the CRM: publish jobs, work leads, and partner with delivery on replacements.
